agent_explanation: Two ~17.7-mass bodies (1 and 2) undergo a deep close encounter: separation shrinks 1.13 (step24) -> 0.72 (step25) -> 0.336 (step26) while speeds rise to ~11.5/12.2. Substeps per outer step stay capped at 6 despite the strongly growing softened acceleration, so the fixed-substep leapfrog cannot resolve the pericenter passage. Kinetic energy jumps 1407->1865->2683 and potential -1320->-1763->-2730 in two steps, with a ~150 net energy swing in the final step, breaching the 2% energy tolerance while momentum stays conserved — a purely numerical integration-accuracy failure.
